title.rendered: Walk by the Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh. The Christian life is a walk, not a sprint, not a clenched-teeth battle. The Spirit is the One you walk with.

content.rendered:
Walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh. Not try harder. Not white-knuckle. Walk. The Christian life is a walk, and the Spirit is the One you walk with.

The Gospel For Today | Monday, June 1, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.”
Galatians 5:16 (NIV)

Today’s Message

The Christian life is described over and over in the New Testament with one word: walk. Walk in the light. Walk by faith. Walk in love. Walk worthy of your calling. Walk in good works. Walk by the Spirit. The picture is not a sprint. It is not a battle of clenched teeth. It is the steady, ordinary movement of someone who is going somewhere with someone.

Paul writes Galatians to a church that had started in the Spirit and was trying to perfect itself in the flesh. They had begun walking with God and somewhere along the way had picked up a rule book and tried to walk the rest of the way by their own willpower. And it was not working. The flesh, Paul tells them, cannot be defeated by the flesh. You cannot out-discipline what is inside you. You cannot fight bitterness with effort. You cannot kill lust with shame. You cannot manufacture love by trying harder to love.

What you can do is walk by the Spirit. And what Paul promises is that as you walk by the Spirit, the desires of the flesh will lose their grip. Not because you have crushed them. Because you have outgrown them. The way light displaces darkness, not by shouting at it, but by simply showing up.

To walk by the Spirit is to take the next small step in the direction He is leading. To listen for His nudge in your conversations. To obey when He whispers to forgive. To stop when He says wait. To start when He says now. To worship when He prompts. To pray when He stirs. A walk is many small steps. Most of them feel like nothing. The cumulative result is a life lived in step with God.

You do not need to figure out the rest of your life this morning. You only need to take the next step with the Spirit. That is all walking has ever required.

Prayer

Father, thank You for the Holy Spirit who walks with me through every hour of this day. I do not want to live by sheer willpower or constant striving. I want to walk with You. Tune my ear to Your voice. Give me grace to take the next step You show me. Quiet the desires of the flesh by Your indwelling presence. Let this be a day of small, faithful steps in step with the Spirit. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I walk by the Spirit. I do not gratify the desires of the flesh. The Holy Spirit lives in me, leads me, and empowers me. Today I take the next step in the direction He is showing me. I am not striving. I am walking. And the One I walk with is faithful.
